# cpp11 documentation fixture

`cpp11_0.5.2.tar.gz` is the unmodified [CRAN source archive](https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/cpp11/cpp11_0.5.2.tar.gz).
Its SHA-256 is `0e8ac07f9d599b82e7a811f9d084e5125ae787b1ba04e5ba57f79e2642af091b`.
cpp11 declares `MIT + file LICENSE`; the original copyright notice is retained in the archive.

The documentation workflow installs this package into a temporary library and reads its prebuilt “Converting from Rcpp” HTML vignette.
Pinning the archive keeps the transcript independent of package updates and host libraries.
Installation needs no compilation, additional R packages, vignette rendering, or network access.
